admission.justification: The member boundaries together protect the end-to-end promise: a concern alone cannot constrain writes or remediation, and a slot guard alone cannot preserve request/report identity and primary-chat ownership.

guarantee: A caller-owned sprint/master Investigator selection admits only its authorized non-leaf scope, keeps the complete not-closed set within eight slots across both starts and completed-recipient new turns, and preserves each selected request UUID through bounded listing, exact reports, replay, Retry, Revive and dashboard remount without replacing the primary document coordinator.
title: Selected Investigator execution remains bounded and exactly addressable
